en.body: Top miles pay $0.72 per mile, and you get weekly pay every week without waiting. Regional runs keep you closer to home. If you hold a Class A CDL and want steady freight, this is a solid seat.

en.hook: Weekly pay. Class A regional seat open.
en.body: You get paid every week — $0.60 to $0.72 per mile depending on the run. Regional lanes, Class A CDL required. If you want a consistent check and miles you can count on, come drive with us.

en.body: Pay runs $0.60 to $0.72 per mile on regional freight. Weekly pay means your check lands every week. Hold a Class A CDL? This regional seat is worth a look.
